slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Jo tumhari life jee nahi rahe, unhe har decision ka answer dena zaroori nahi.
Sabko khush karne ki koshish me apni direction lose ho jaati hai.
Respectful boundary ke liye long explanation dena zaroori nahi.
Har relationship ko same access dena zaroori nahi. Apni energy choose karo.
Ek unnecessary debate end karo aur ek important priority protect karo.
Tum selfish nahi ho. Tum apni energy ko intentional bana rahe ho.

caption:
Har decision ko explain karna zaroori nahi.

Aaj ek healthy boundary set karo aur apni peace ko priority do.
